checks.name: verified-requesting-account
checks.run:
from mission_control.drive_account_contract import identity
r=identity({'user':{'permissionId':'synthetic','me':True,'kind':'drive#user'}})
assert r=={'permission_id':'synthetic'}, 'Requesting identity must be normalized'

checks.name: exact-connection-binding
checks.run:
from mission_control.drive_account_contract import connection_binding
r=dict(app_id='sample-one',id='synthetic',version=1,data={'account':{'permission_id':'one'},'selected_files':['a']},expires=600)
a=connection_binding(r)
assert isinstance(a,str) and len(a)==64
assert a!=connection_binding(dict(r,version=2)), 'Revision must alter protected credential context'

checks.name: actual-durable-confirmation
checks.run:
import unittest
s=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.test_drive_accounts')
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(s)
assert r.wasSuccessful() and not r.skipped, 'Durable account confirmation and disconnect must pass'
